changes: Add scratchpads with ordinary text jots, parent-page composers, newest-first history, inline editing, and confirmed permanent deletion through validated actions.
Add fixed proportional weekly schedules, untimed day items, week notes and goals, consistent ISO date entry, and year-aware abbreviated date ranges. Keep schedules fixed when events overlap.
Add checkbox log prompts and vertically arranged answers while preserving historical prompt snapshots. Add Top and Bottom ordering controls, newer todos first, and embedded todo creation.
Add MOSS UI with saved light and dark schemes, configurable home and top-down startup, and editable navigation to nodes and allowlisted built-in system views.

Add reusable display styles with separate parent and opened-node selections, a Calendar Current week parent style, an expandable UI catalog, and Python-validated presentation files outside node content.
Extend internal links to system views and preserve presentation references during node renames. Keep missing references visible and default styles backward-compatible.

Preserve clean first-launch initialization, installation-relative storage, local-only serving, occupied-port isolation, and read-only projections. Derive terminal type help and child navigation from the canonical schema and list actions from the shared catalog.

Update public documentation for setup, upgrades, backup recovery, architecture, agent access, and extensions. Keep the public release free of workspace data and record tested direct dependency versions.
Establish MOSS v1 as the baseline for the reusable code, separate from personal workspace data.
Retain the file-backed node and action model, Python validation, terminal interface, browser renderers, and existing node types.
Add the MOSS Change log system page and read-only API, backed by release notes stored with the code rather than personal memory.
Stop terminal startup from recording the obsolete v0.2 core version in the memory action log.
Document release versioning: code changes receive release notes; commands and memory edits remain in the action log.
Hide randomizer titles on parent pages by default, with a Show title on parent page option. Keep selected text and the title on the direct node view.
